description: Says whether a thread of a mailbox leaves the Inbox for the Archive as soon as the box answers it, whether the answer is written in the webmail, through these tools or in a mail app such as Thunderbird. The thread comes back to the Inbox when a new message arrives in it. A setting of the box: on a box held by several people it moves the thread for all of them. A helpdesk queue refuses it, its threads being worked by status.

archive_on_reply.description: True to archive answered threads, false to leave them in the Inbox.

name: set_archive_on_reply
title: Archive a thread once it is answered
